name_input: S T G INFRASTRUCTURE PVT LTD
export_evidence: No shipment row was rendered on any accessible source. ImportKey page https://importkey.com/countries/india/stg-infrastructure-pvt-ltd (and variant /stg-infrastructure-pvt-ltd) returned only the generic paywall template: "Join ImportKey to view the import and export data records of companies all over the world." — zero bill-of-lading rows, zero dates, zero destinations, zero HS codes actually seen (source counter: 2 ImportKey URLs fetched, 0 shipment records displayed). volza.com, eximpedia.app and trademo.com returned HTTP 403; importgenius.com returned a JavaScript challenge page. No export record with date/destination/HS/B-L number could be retrieved.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract or annual-report split could be retrieved. The DuckDuckGo search backend failed on every attempt ("searx: <urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused>"), so no registry, tender or financial page could be located; zaubacorp.com returned HTTP 403. Zero domestic supply records seen.
note: Evidence could not be gathered: the search tool was non-functional for the whole run (connection refused on 3 attempts) and every free trade-data source was blocked (403 / JS challenge) or paywalled. Both statuses are therefore 'unknown' — this is a tooling failure, NOT a finding that shipments are absent. Per Rule 5, no 'declared, not confirmed' or 'conditionally accepted' wording is used, and no shipment, date, HS code, B-L number, CIN, PAN or turnover figure has been invented. Declared HS 732290 (iron/steel articles, construction & DIY) is unverified against any actual record. Company is NOT rejected: no evidence of non-existence, liquidation or bankruptcy was found either — the legal entity's status is simply unverified. Recommended follow-up: re-run with a working search backend and a paid/authenticated ImportKey, Volza or Eximpedia account, plus MCA master-data lookup for the exact registered name and CIN.
